svg.title: Selected donor composition, measurement depth, age and batch
svg.desc: Two separately labeled cohort panels; one column per donor. Author state labels are not harmonized across cohorts. Counts are primary cells or nuclei, not read depth or purity.

g.text: Selected donors: composition, primary-lineage counts, age and batch
Descriptive audit only. Each column is one person; source states are retained without cross-cohort harmonization.
Author QC is inherited. Cell/nucleus count is measurement depth, not purity or independent patient replication.
Denominators: all retained primary cells/nuclei in that donor. Observed zero labels remain zero; annotation absence is not biological absence.
Complete selected cohorts shown; 44/44 ages available. Batch strings are source-specific. No disease test, subtype fit or causal adjustment is added.
